biggest_catch: You have to pass verification (background check + ID, 2–3 business days) before you can work a single shift — and shifts are hospitality-only in Qwick's markets.
catches: Verification takes 2–3 business days (background check, ID) before you can accept shifts.
Hospitality-only roles (bartender, server, line cook, dishwasher, etc.) in Qwick's metro markets — no shifts if your city isn't covered.
You keep 100% of shift earnings (no pro fees), but you are paid the posted shift rate — negotiate nothing.
Ratings matter: top-rated pros get priority matching and higher-paying shifts.

timing: Same-day: paid via direct deposit the same day your shift ends, hitting your account immediately after clock-out.
who_pays: Qwick pays you the posted shift rate — there are no fees or subscriptions for professionals, so you keep 100% of what you earn from every shift.
